final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_rate FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_rate FROM fees), above_benchmark AS (SELECT p.avg_rebate, p.avg_net_rate, p.avg_net_rate - b.avg_net_rate AS excess_rate FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_net_rate > b.avg_net_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_rebate) AS avg_average_total_rebate, AVG(avg_net_rate) AS avg_average_net_fee_rate, AVG(excess_rate) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM above_benchmark
